package: UI-2: WP-10 approval card, WP-18 error wording, WP-15 link popover
screenshots: Each case saves <name>-<light|dark>-<desktop|phone>.png into UI_CASE_SHOTS (desktop 1280 px, phone 375 px); the pictures are not kept in git.

modes.live: Driven end to end on the running stack with the scripted model and SaaS.
modes.replay: The real chat page on the running stack, with the server's frames for that turn replayed: the scripted model cannot produce this case (an engine's held edit, an outage, an erased conversation, a gVisor-less server, a spent budget, an unconnected toolset).

cases.title: An engine edit's approval card shows its diff and the declared cost
steps: Open a conversation whose coding engine run waits on an edit of docs/launch-plan.md (approval with effect.diff and effect.costEstimate 0.04).
expected: The card shows 'What changes' with the file name and the changed lines, removed in red and added in green.
It shows 'Estimated cost: about $0.04 · as the tool states it'.
The raw arguments (old_string/new_string) are not shown.

cases.title: A long diff is folded and says when the worker cut it
steps: Open a held edit whose diff has 41 lines and diffTruncated true.
expected: First 12 lines are shown, with the note that the change is longer than the card can show.
After the click all 41 lines show.

cases.title: Deny with a reason reaches the harness; the receipt quotes it
steps: As the tool agent, send a turn whose model calls create_ticket (the org asks before writes).
Click Deny on the card; type 'Post it in #team-updates, not #general'.
expected: Deny opens 'Why not? (optional, the agent reads this)' with a character counter, Cancel and Deny.
The decision POST carries {decision: denied, reason}.
The run ends; nothing reaches the SaaS; the receipt reads 'Denied by you, because “…”'.

cases.title: A batch of three calls is one card with Allow all 3
steps: Send a turn whose model calls create_ticket three times in one step.
expected: One grouped card lists the three tickets, with Review each, Deny all and Allow all 3.
After Allow all 3 the run does all three calls and answers 'Filed all three.'

cases.title: A plain link in an answer opens directly
steps: Send a turn whose answer links https://docs.acme.dev/release-notes.
expected: The link points at the address itself and is not marked as carrying data.

cases.title: A link whose address carries data asks first and names the host
steps: In the same answer, click the link to https://reports.example.net/view?user=…&token=….
expected: The visible href is the address without its query.
A popover 'This link sends extra data' names reports.example.net; 'Open link' carries the full address.

cases.title: ACCESS_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: an outage says to wait, with Try again
steps: Send a message; the server refuses it 503 HTTP_AGENT_HARNESS_ACCESS_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE.
expected: 'Your organization's AI rules couldn't be read just now, so nothing was sent. Wait a moment, then send it again.'
Never 'pick another model'.
A 'Try again' button sends the question again.

cases.title: SESSION_ERASED: the conversation was deleted, with New chat
steps: Send a message; the server refuses it 410 HTTP_AGENT_HARNESS_SESSION_ERASED.
expected: 'This conversation was deleted. Start a new chat to keep going.' with a 'New chat' button.

cases.title: gvisor_unavailable: ask the admin, with the install guide
steps: Send a message; the run ends RUN_ERROR code gvisor_unavailable.
expected: 'Coding engines need the gVisor sandbox runtime on this server. Ask your admin to install it — install guide: …GVISOR.md'.
No button: the step is the admin's.

cases.title: budget_exhausted: ask the admin, or ask for less
steps: Send a message; the turn ends with an error answer, errorCode budget_exhausted.
expected: 'This reply stopped because it reached its spending limit. Ask your admin to raise the limit, or ask for less at a time.'
No button.

cases.title: budget_insufficient: ask the admin, or ask for less
steps: Send a message; the turn ends with an error answer, errorCode budget_insufficient.
expected: 'This reply stopped because its spending limit had too little left for the next step. Ask your admin to raise the limit, or ask for less at a time.'
No button.

cases.title: tool_unavailable: a Connect row under the search step
steps: Send a message; the run's search_tools step finds jira__create_issue (not_authenticated) and goldencrm__close_deal (not_attached).
expected: 'Jira · Create issue isn't connected' with Connect linking /workspace/actions/personal/?toolsetType=jira.
'Goldencrm · Close deal isn't available to this agent' with no button.
The server's English message is not shown.
